name: Steve Duerr
occupation: Jackson attorney; general counsel for Lower Valley Energy (30-plus years as of 2022); former executive director of the Jackson Hole Chamber of Commerce (1999–2006) and of the Murie Center (2008–2012)
background: Moved to Jackson Hole from Minnesota with his family in 1985. As of his 2022 announcement he had practiced law for 42 years, served as general counsel for Lower Valley Energy for more than 30 years, and previously led the Jackson Hole Chamber of Commerce (1999–2006) and the Murie Center (2008–2012). Civic roles listed in the announcement included founding board member of the Jackson Hole Center for Global Affairs, 30-year Jackson Hole Rotary member, co-chair of Community Entry Services and court-appointed guardian, hospice volunteer at St. John’s Hospital, and board member of the Curran-Seeley Foundation.
